t: You're at Lincoln's Inn, one of the four Inns of Court in London. To practise as a barrister in England and Wales, you must belong to one of these inns. The others are Middle Temple, Inner Temple and Gray's Inn. Several notable people died here. John Thurloe, spymaster for Oliver Cromwell, belonged to this Inn. Henry de Lacy, Earl of Lincoln, was a confidant of Edward the First. William Talbot, the first Earl Talbot, was a Whig politician who became Lord Steward of the Household. John Augustus Francis Simpkinson is buried here.
